note: Recorded caps. `reference_win` = the owner reference machine (STATUS.md: i7-12700KF, Windows 11; both gate interpreters), measured 2026-10-18: recorded_* are representative numbers, load_envelope_avg_ms is the observed per-run range while the owner's desktop kept working (editor/browser/VM churn; a loaded run can be ~1.7x a quiet one), avg_cap_ms carries ~20% headroom over the envelope maximum and decides the gate, p99_cap_ms is a loose hitch guard only (p99 under desktop load reaches 100-400 ms on the 3D rows). `ACA_BENCH_SET=owner` enforces the raw 6.22 budgets (quiet-machine certification run, `--runs=3` recommended); `ACA_BENCH_SET=sandbox_linux` keeps the Arena-sandbox caps (2026-10-16, ~1.5x headroom). Caps catch regressions; they do not certify 6.22 - measured 2026-10-18: 2D 15.3-26.9 ms vs 10 ms, office3d q2 46-108 ms vs 20 ms, depot3d q2 37-68 ms vs 12 ms (BUGS B-040).

office3d.note: Phase 11: cutscene render at 480x270 internal, quality high. Sandbox-recorded 2026-10-16 after steps 1-4; caps carry ~1.4x headroom. p99 caps carry extra headroom: sandbox p99 is load-sensitive (CI runs the bench after the 46 s loop row); avg is the regression signal.

depot3d.note: Phase 11: Mission 0 depot outro, quality 2 (DOF + textures). Sandbox re-recorded 2026-10-16 after step 9: palette textures cost ~+12 ms at tier 2 in the sandbox (software affine rasterizer, stride path for big quads); tiers q1/q0 are the low-end answer. Owner re-certifies the 12 ms budget on target hardware.

depot3d_q1.note: Depot at quality 1: render scale 0.75, no DOF, cast shadows baked, textures on. Sandbox re-recorded 2026-10-16 after step 9.

depot3d_q0.note: Depot at quality 0: render scale 0.6, no local lights/shadows/post. Sandbox-recorded 2026-10-16 (P11 low-end pass).

office3d_q1.note: Office at quality 1 (legacy 0.6 buffer, fewer lights, no DOF). Sandbox-recorded 2026-10-16 (P11 low-end pass). p99 caps carry extra headroom: sandbox p99 is load-sensitive (CI runs the bench after the 46 s loop row); avg is the regression signal.

office3d_q0.note: Office at quality 0 (all P11 features off). Sandbox-recorded 2026-10-16 (P11 low-end pass). p99 caps carry extra headroom: sandbox p99 is load-sensitive (CI runs the bench after the 46 s loop row); avg is the regression signal.
